freshness_policy.max_allowed_age_description: Lifecycle state must reflect the latest persisted proposal event and immutable version evidence for the requested proposal.

Memo evidence pack freshness will be measured against immutable proposal version evidence, memo section readiness, source-authority manifest, report/archive posture, and finalized memo review events. Until memo APIs and persistence are implemented, telemetry remains blocked and the product must not be advertised as supported.

Proposal narrative evidence is current when it reflects the immutable proposal version artifact, latest narrative review event, source narrative hash, and reviewed report-request package posture for the requested proposal version.

Bulk review campaign membership is generated from the source-backed candidate set supplied inline or through an immutable BulkReviewCampaignDefinition:v1 definition plus optional governance evidence for the requested campaign as-of date. Preview-readiness evaluates persisted definition lifecycle, requested as-of date, source-backed candidate eligibility, governance approval, expiry, and optional actor entitlement before new preview/create use. Workflow overview composes discovery, preview-readiness, lifecycle-event, launch-history, approval decisions, assignment actions, assignment tasks, maker-checker controls, and optional launch-package posture without discovering the global portfolio universe or recalculating membership. The operating queue classifies persisted definitions into launch-ready, attention-required, and closed rows from existing discovery, preview-readiness, lifecycle, launch-history, and approval posture without adding order or OMS claims. The approval inbox classifies persisted definitions into approval-complete, approval-required, approval-incomplete, expiry-attention, entitlement-attention, and closed rows from existing governance evidence and readiness posture without adding trade-approval, order, or OMS claims. The workflow board composes the existing operating queue and approval inbox into actor-aware next-action rows for launch, approval-decision capture, approval evidence remediation, expiry refresh, entitlement review, or closed posture without mutating approval state. The assignment plan derives read-only actor routing, escalation tier, SLA posture, and reason codes from the workflow board without mutating assignment state or creating escalation tasks. The workflow automation projection composes assignment-plan and assignment-task state into read-only automation candidates for opening, monitoring, or escalating Manage-owned assignment tasks without automatic task mutation, external workflow orchestration, client contact, maker-checker workflow, order generation, or OMS claims. Assignment actions provide append-only assignment, reassignment, escalation, de-escalation, and resolution posture evidence on active definitions without approval-state mutation, trade approval, order, client-contact, maker-checker, or OMS claims. Assignment tasks provide controlled assignment and escalation task state with append-only transition evidence, idempotent task/transition refs, status counts, escalation counts, and SLA posture counts without approval-state mutation, trade approval, order generation or routing, client contact, external workflow orchestration, maker-checker, or OMS claims. Approval decisions provide append-only campaign approval posture evidence on active definitions without trade approval, order, client-contact, maker-checker, or OMS claims. Maker-checker controls provide append-only campaign control evidence on active definitions with actor separation required for completed reviews, without trade approval, order generation or routing, client contact, external workflow orchestration, or OMS claims. Launch packages provide a bounded preview/create request draft and required headers without recalculating campaign membership. Durable definition launch consumes the same readiness package, creates one wave only when ready, replays by deterministic launch idempotency, and records append-only launch history for wave lineage.

PM operating quality score runs are generated from explicit bank policy, bank approval and fairness-review evidence, current source-backed evidence supplied or referenced by the request, and optional lotus-core PortfolioManagerBookMembership:v1 scope materialization. Fairness analyses are generated from persisted score runs and source-defined operating segments. Review actions are immutable ledger rows over existing score-run or fairness-analysis evidence and preserve target content hashes without recalculating scores or recomputing fairness posture. Summary invocations are immutable history rows over existing score-run and review-action evidence and carry PM_QUALITY_SUMMARY_TEXT_BOUNDARY evidence proving Manage records workflow, run, artifact refs, and hashes only, without storing or exposing generated summary text or projecting downstream summary UX. Portfolio memory projects bounded score-run lineage only when persisted Core PM-book member evidence includes the requested portfolio.
Portfolio action registers are refreshed from current management workflow state and governed portfolio-state inputs.
Stateful attribution is recalculated from governed lotus-core portfolio, position, benchmark, classification, and FX source inputs for the requested as-of date and measurement window.
Exposure rows must stay aligned to the benchmark performance context and resolved benchmark version for the requested as-of date.

Composite performance is calculated from governed persisted member-return facts for the requested composite period and must carry source-fact lineage, membership policy, and restatement/version evidence before client-facing publication.
Stateful contribution is recalculated from governed lotus-core portfolio and position analytics inputs for the requested as-of date and measurement window.
Mandate performance health context is derived from source-owned portfolio and benchmark period-return evidence for the requested as-of date and period.
Stateful MWR is recalculated from governed upstream portfolio observations for the requested as-of date and measurement window.
Stateful series are recalculated from governed upstream data for the requested as-of date and window.
Stateful TWR is recalculated from governed upstream portfolio observations for the requested as-of date and measurement window.
Client report evidence packs are generated from the latest certified upstream portfolio, performance, and risk evidence for the reporting as-of date.
Concentration analytics must reflect the resolved current or simulated portfolio state for the requested as-of date.
Drawdown analytics must remain tied to the resolved return path and benchmark policy used for the requested as-of date.
Historical attribution must stay aligned to the requested as-of date, upstream return series, exposure history, and benchmark context.
Mandate risk health context must reflect source-owned tracking-error methodology, the requested as-of date, and the supplied portfolio and benchmark return observations.
Regime scenario-pack evaluation must reflect the governed scenario pack and caller-supplied exposure weights for the requested as-of date.
Risk-event affected cohorts must reflect the governed risk-event definition, supplied candidate portfolios, and source-supplied exposure weights for the requested as-of date.
Risk metrics must reflect the requested as-of date and the resolved upstream return series used for the calculation.
Rolling risk metrics must stay aligned to the requested return window and explicit risk-free treatment.

dependencies.business_purpose: Resolve canonical holdings and cash-balance context for stateful proposal simulation, workspace evaluation, and advisory lifecycle continuity.

Resolve Advise-owned tactical house-view affected cohorts for discretionary rebalance wave preview and creation while preserving lotus-advise house-view, candidate, supportability, content hash, and source refs without recomputing advisory, house-view, holdings, exposure, alignment, or mandate facts in lotus-manage.

Preserve source-owned benchmark identity in mandate-health lineage and DPM supportability evidence without calculating benchmark composition, active-risk, performance attribution, model approval, or benchmark analytics methodology in lotus-manage.
Resolve source-owned CIO model-change affected-mandate cohorts for rebalance wave preview and creation without caller-supplied portfolio fabrication or local cohort discovery.

Preserve source-owned client income-needs schedule evidence in mandate-health lineage and liquidity-aware construction diagnostics without inferring financial-planning advice, funding recommendations, or client liability planning in lotus-manage.
Block discretionary construction alternatives that violate hard client restrictions while preserving source lineage and degraded-state reason codes for proof-pack review.
Resolve mandate, model, policy-pack, booking-center, jurisdiction, review cadence, and objective binding for stateful DPM workflows while preserving lotus-core as mandate administration authority.
Resolve model portfolio target weights, model version, target bands, and source lineage for stateful discretionary mandate execution without making lotus-manage the model-governance authority.
Resolve composed DPM source-readiness posture, missing source families, and data-quality mapping for stateful mandate workflows without locally reassembling source-owner readiness semantics.

Preserve fail-closed external treasury currency exposure posture in currency-overlay construction diagnostics so unavailable bank-owned treasury ingestion blocks hedge realization without claiming FX attribution, hedge advice, treasury instruction, execution readiness, OMS acknowledgement, fills, settlement, or autonomous treasury action.

Preserve fail-closed external treasury eligible hedge instrument posture in currency-overlay construction diagnostics so unavailable bank-owned treasury ingestion blocks hedge realization without claiming eligible-instrument selection, suitability approval, product recommendation, treasury instruction, counterparty selection, best execution, OMS acknowledgement, fills, settlement, or autonomous treasury action.

Preserve fail-closed external treasury FX forward-curve posture in currency-overlay construction diagnostics so unavailable bank-owned treasury ingestion blocks hedge realization without claiming forward pricing, FX valuation methodology, hedge advice, treasury instruction, counterparty selection, best execution, OMS acknowledgement, fills, settlement, or autonomous treasury action.

Preserve fail-closed external treasury readiness posture in currency-overlay construction diagnostics so unavailable treasury ingestion blocks hedge realization without claiming hedge advice, forward pricing, counterparty selection, best execution, OMS acknowledgement, fills, settlement, or autonomous treasury action.

Preserve fail-closed external treasury hedge-policy posture in currency-overlay construction diagnostics so unavailable bank-owned treasury ingestion blocks hedge realization without claiming hedge-policy approval, hedge advice, treasury instruction, counterparty selection, OMS acknowledgement, fills, settlement, or autonomous treasury action.

Preserve fail-closed external OMS acknowledgement posture in construction diagnostics, outcome-review evidence, report input, AI evidence input, and portfolio-memory boundary events without claiming execution, fills, settlement, or OMS ingestion.

Resolve buy/sell eligibility, shelf status, restriction reasons, settlement, liquidity-tier, issuer, asset-class, and country-of-risk source evidence for DPM universe and diagnostics without local eligibility ownership.

Preserve source-owned liquidity reserve requirements in mandate-health lineage and liquidity-aware construction diagnostics while keeping local DPM execution bounded to policy review and supportability evidence.
Preserve source-owned price and FX coverage freshness posture for stateful DPM source readiness and mandate health without valuation methodology or FX attribution ownership.
Preserve source-owned planned withdrawal schedules in liquidity-aware construction diagnostics without treating withdrawals as OMS instructions, execution forecasts, or treasury actions.

Preserve source-owned projected net-cashflow pressure in mandate-health lineage and liquidity-aware construction diagnostics without cashflow forecasting, funding recommendation, or financial-planning advice claims.
Resolve source-owned PM-book scope for rebalance-wave discovery and optional PM operating quality score-run materialization without inferring book membership in lotus-manage.
Run discretionary rebalance simulation and what-if analysis from a governed portfolio-state snapshot supplied through the current management request contract.
Preserve source-owned tax-lot window evidence for tax-aware construction diagnostics and source-readiness posture without tax advice, tax optimization, or tax-reporting certification claims.
Preserve source-backed sustainability preferences in construction alternatives and proof packs, including allocation review posture, without inferring unsupported ESG classifications.

Preserve source-owned mandate performance health posture in mandate-health recalculation and use the source product health_state and threshold posture for bounded PERFORMANCE_ATTENTION without calculating performance attribution, active return, benchmark-relative, or FX methodology in lotus-manage.

Preserve source-owned mandate risk health posture in mandate-health recalculation and use the source product health_state and threshold posture for bounded RISK_DRIFT attention without calculating tracking error, volatility, drawdown, or benchmark risk methodology in lotus-manage.

Resolve source-owned regime scenario-pack evaluation for regime-stress-aware construction and proof-pack scenario evidence without local scenario methodology, contribution, CIO approval, effective-period, or applicability calculation.

Resolve source-owned risk-event affected portfolio cohorts for discretionary rebalance wave preview and creation while preserving lotus-risk lineage, supportability, request fingerprint, and reason codes without recalculating risk-event impact in lotus-manage.
